title: Her Mother Never Raises Her Voice — Part 5

series.summary: Hakari begs to be let out of her own house while her mother stays calmly seated and decides she will not leave until high school ends.

segments.voiceover_text: Hakari turns from the window and says she is going home now. The refusal reaches her before she even gets near the door.
Now she is begging out loud, held back by hands she cannot shake off, while a voice lists everything she is supposedly worth.
Her mother stays seated through all of it, unhurried, one finger resting at her lip. She never raises her voice. She never needs to.
Then she pulls Hakari's head against her chest and shuts her eyes. Hakari stays inside this house until high school is over.
